description: NaLi₃Fe₄(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.39 Å. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.49 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.52 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.51 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.14 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.17 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.16 Å. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.16 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-59°. There is one shorter (1.61 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-58°. There is one shorter (1.62 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-59°. There is one shorter (1.62 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Li and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Li, two Fe, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Fe, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Li, two Fe, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLiFe₂Si tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to one Li, two Fe, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLiFe₂Si trigonal pyramids.
